name: image-skill-studio
description: A Codex MCP App for discovering image-generation Skills, handing work to the current agent, and collecting results by Skill.

interface.shortDescription: Hand image Skill work to Codex and collect the results
interface.longDescription: Choose a curated image-generation Skill in an MCP App sidebar, explore prompt-backed examples, compose with optional reference images, hand the immutable work item to the current Codex agent, collect results under that Skill, and export 1080 by 1440 Xiaohongshu comparison cards.
